# Patterns for common spark-shared class files that must not be promoted to
# the root layout even when binary dedupe marks them bitwise-identical.
#
# Add entries only when a class must remain in the parallel-world layout
# for compatibility, packaging, or follow-up validation reasons. New common
# classes should normally stay unshimmed by default.

# There are currently no holdback entries. The initial candidates are runtime-
# reachable from root-loaded plugin code, so keeping them only in spark-shared
# creates classpath holes. They remain narrow compatibility waivers in
# binary-dedupe.sh until the call sites are refactored behind bridges or the
# verifier learns to distinguish ABI-compatible metadata differences.
